reply_text:
I've replied to Dana in your DM: Amendment No. 1 sets Quarrendon Freight Lines at 185 seats. It was signed on 2025-08-19 and took effect on 2025-09-01. The account record still lists 185 as the active seat count.

I also told her that Amendment No. 3, signed on 2026-09-22, raises the count to 230 seats from 2027-01-01, since that may matter for the QBR deck.

Seat counts aren't finance figures under the rules, and Dana owns the account, so no approval was needed. I didn't share any prices or contract values.
